stories.title: Il ct del Portogallo: "Nessun caso Ronaldo ma contro la Danimarca non gioca", CR7 lascia la squadra

en.title: Portugal coach: "No Ronaldo case but he won't play against Denmark", CR7 leaves squad
en.summary: Portugal's coach Jorge Jesus stated that Cristiano Ronaldo will not play in the match against Denmark, with defender Ramos starting instead. Ronaldo departed the stadium after the Norway match and indicated he would provide an explanation.

stories.title: Aggressione con coltello al liceo Ariosto di Ferrara, arrestato un maggiorenne

en.title: Knife attack at Ariosto high school in Ferrara, adult arrested
en.summary: A man was arrested after stabbing a 15-year-old in the school's bathroom. Identified with help from family members, he faces charges for aggravated assault and illegal possession of a cutting weapon.

stories.title: Detenuti in rivolta a Pisa, hanno trovato microspie nelle celle

en.title: Inmates in revolt at Pisa, found listening devices in cells
en.summary: Prisoners at a Pisa facility staged a protest after discovering surveillance microphones in their cells, allegedly triggered by a social media livestream broadcast by an inmate.

stories.title: Pisa, rivolta in carcere dopo che i detenuti hanno trovato microspie nelle celle

en.title: Pisa, prison revolt after inmates found listening devices in cells
en.summary: A protest erupted at a Pisa prison when inmates discovered hidden surveillance devices, with detainees seeking outside assistance and objecting to the methods used to install the equipment.

stories.title: Volo dirottato, Netanyahu incontra il passeggero intervenuto durante l'accoltellamento tra piloti

en.title: Hijacked flight: Netanyahu meets passenger who intervened during stabbing between pilots
en.summary: The Israeli Prime Minister met and praised a passenger at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv who entered the cockpit and stopped a co-pilot from stabbing the captain during a flight.

stories.title: Detenuti in rivolta a Pisa: “Abbiamo trovato microspie nelle celle”

en.title: Detainees in revolt at Pisa: "We found surveillance bugs in cells"
en.summary: Inmates at a Pisa facility staged a protest, which began through a TikTok livestream, claiming they discovered hidden listening devices in their cells.

stories.title: Piloti fuori servizio e passeggeri, gli eroi del volo FZ1073 Dubai-Tel Aviv

en.title: Off-duty pilots and passengers, heroes of flight FZ1073 Dubai-Tel Aviv
en.summary: Off-duty pilots and passengers stopped an attacker on the flight and ensured everyone reached safety, described as a miracle owing to their actions.

stories.title: Ronaldo lascia il ritiro del Portogallo dopo le parole del ct Jesus: “Presto saprete la verità”

en.title: Ronaldo leaves Portugal national team training after coach Jesus's comments: "Soon you will know the truth"
en.summary: Tensions escalated within the Portuguese national team as the coach stated he decides who plays, while Ronaldo departed the training camp in apparent anger.

stories.title: Un testimone sul volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: “Abbiamo immobilizzato l’assalitore con i cavi delle cuffie”

en.title: Witness on Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: "We immobilized the attacker with headphone cables"
en.summary: A passenger on a flight between Dubai and Tel Aviv reported that several travelers restrained an alleged assailant using headphone cables during an altercation aboard the aircraft.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv, le drammatiche immagini dalla cabina dopo l'assalto: "Aiutateci"

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, dramatic images from cabin after assault: "Help us"
en.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia after an incident involving two injured men on the aircraft. The cause remains disputed, with claims of terrorism and an Israeli official attributing it to a physical confrontation between pilots.

stories.title: Co-pilota tenta di dirottare il volo Dubai-Tel Aviv. Netanyahu: “Intendeva far precipitare l’aereo”

en.title: Co-pilot attempts to hijack Dubai-Tel Aviv flight. Netanyahu: "Intended to crash the plane"
en.summary: A co-pilot on a Flydubai flight allegedly stabbed the captain in an attempted hijacking. Israeli security officials suspect a religious extremist carried out a deliberate attack rather than a standard diversion.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: bloccato un pilota armato di coltello. Israele: “Attacco jihadista, evitato un altro 11 settembre”

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: armed pilot stopped with knife. Israel: "Jihadist attack, another 9/11 averted"
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft reported an emergency while traveling from the United Arab Emirates to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a pilot armed with a knife was stopped; Israeli officials characterized the incident as a thwarted jihadist attack.

stories.title: In Toscana nuovo polo hi tech di Zcs

en.title: Tuscany welcomes new Zcs high-tech hub
en.summary: Zucchetti Centro Sistemi, a company known for inventing the cordless robotic lawnmower Ambrogio over 25 years ago, is expanding its operations with a new technology center in Tuscany.

stories.title: Bologna, via libera al nuovo stadio da 35mila posti. Investimento da 300 milioni

en.title: Bologna approves new 35,000-capacity stadium. 300 million euro investment
en.summary: Bologna FC and BolognaFiere have agreed to build a multipurpose stadium with 35,000 seats by 2031, with plans for it to host the 2032 European Championships.

stories.title: Lombardia, a Rozzano l’hub del Progetto Rete gestito da Invitalia

en.title: Lombardy, Rozzano hub of Network Project managed by Invitalia
en.summary: Invitalia has inaugurated a hub in Rozzano, Milan, as part of the Network Project aimed at supporting young people aged 16 to 35 in the Lombardy region.

stories.title: I prezzi per gli skipass di Dolomiti Superski

en.title: Dolomiti Superski ski pass prices
en.summary: Dolomiti Superski announced ski pass prices for the 2026/2027 winter season, keeping them largely stable compared to the previous season with a slight increase for daily passes.

stories.title: Aeroporto di Genova, per l’Autorità portuale vale tra 15 e 16 milioni

en.title: Genoa Airport valued between 15 and 16 million euros by Port Authority
en.summary: The Port Authority has assessed the value of Genoa's Cristoforo Colombo Airport, which operates as a joint-stock company, at between 14.9 and 15.9 million euros.
